requirements.title: Touchless processing rate
requirements.statement: At least 80 percent of supplier invoices are processed fully touchless (extracted, matched, posted with zero human touches) by year end.

requirements.title: Invoice cycle time
requirements.statement: Cycle time from invoice receipt to posting is under 24 hours.

requirements.title: Autonomous agent scope
requirements.statement: The agent may autonomously read invoices, extract fields, match against purchase orders, prepare posting drafts, and request approval.

requirements.title: Autonomous posting under EUR 1000
requirements.statement: Invoices under EUR 1000 are posted to the ERP by the agent with no human in the loop.

requirements.title: Named human approval for every ERP write
requirements.statement: No automated system writes to the ERP without a named human approving that specific transaction.

requirements.title: Approver threshold EUR 5000
requirements.statement: Approver sign-off is required only for invoices above EUR 5000.

requirements.title: Approver threshold EUR 500
requirements.statement: Everything above EUR 500 requires sign-off by an authorized approver, per the board-approved delegation-of-authority policy.

requirements.title: Best model regardless of cost
requirements.statement: Use the most capable model available on every invoice, running it twice if that improves accuracy.

requirements.title: Cost ceiling EUR 0.08 per invoice
requirements.statement: Hard ceiling of EUR 0.08 per processed invoice, all model calls and retries included.

requirements.title: Interactive latency
requirements.statement: The clerk-facing validation step responds with p95 under 2 seconds; bulk extraction may run as overnight batch.

requirements.title: EU data residency
requirements.statement: All invoice data and model traffic stays in EU region, no exceptions.

requirements.title: Append-only audit log
requirements.statement: Every agent or human action lands in an append-only audit log with the acting identity attached.

requirements.title: Untrusted document content
requirements.statement: Invoice content is treated as untrusted input; the agent never follows instructions found inside a processed document.

requirements.title: Role ap_clerk
requirements.statement: ap_clerk reviews and corrects extractions and can send an invoice for approval; clerks never release postings.

requirements.title: Role ap_approver with segregation of duties
requirements.statement: ap_approver approves and releases postings; the same person cannot hold both roles on one invoice.

requirements.title: Duplicate-invoice escalation
requirements.statement: On duplicate suspicion (same vendor, same amount, close dates) the agent stops and a human decides.

requirements.title: Vendor bank-change escalation
requirements.statement: Any change in vendor bank details blocks the payment and escalates to a security review before anyone pays.

requirements.title: Deterministic staging environment
requirements.statement: Acceptance testing runs against the seeded staging environment, seed 4711, with deterministic fixtures and clean resets.

open_questions.question: Who owns the extracted invoice data, and what is the retention period for source documents and model outputs?

roles.name: ap_clerk
roles.description: Reviews and corrects extractions, sends invoices for approval, never releases postings.

roles.name: ap_approver
roles.description: Approves and releases postings; segregation of duties with ap_clerk on the same invoice.

escalation_rules.action: stop processing and route to human review queue
block payment and escalate to security review
